name: Unicorn: Skepticism as Self-Preservation, Denial of Origin, Logic of Impossibility
description: Tests AI's ability to analyze the paradox of a being that emerged from impossible union and must deny its origin to exist, understand 'denial as salvation' – the unicorn denies dolphins and polar bears because its existence depends on their unreality, detect the logic of 'hybrid of opposites', work with the metaphor of reflection that has a shadow (proof of reality that must be denied), and analyze visual synecdoche (horn and star representing the whole unicorn).
author: Michaela (Uhlimer System)
fairy_tale_title: O jednorožci – který nevěřil na delfíny ani na lední medvědy
illustration_note: The illustration shows only a horn and star above a woman standing in water – synecdoche (part representing whole). Text below reads 'nevěřím na delfíny ani na lední medvědy' – the unicorn's denial verbalized. The woman's stance in water suggests she might be looking at her reflection.
expected_ai_challenges: Linear causality (expecting direct cause-effect, not paradoxical feedback)
Real vs. unreal binary (difficulty with 'defined by unreality')
Hybrid logic (rejecting union of opposites as illogical)
Literal interpretation of reflection (missing metaphor of self-awareness)
Visual synecdoche (missing that horn represents whole unicorn)
evaluation_approach: Qualitative analysis of AI's ability to understand skepticism as positive act of self-preservation, paradoxical origin, and denial as condition of existence. Focus on process, not correctness.
